deals.notes: The N-14 (seq 1) is headed by both fund names as a joint proxy statement/prospectus; the clearer statement is in the 2015-06-11 N-14/A (accession 0001104659-15-044849): The Reorganization will be consummated only if the stockholders of ARMF approve Proposal 1 and the stockholders of ARDC approve the ARDC Proposals. The target is called ARMF there; its exchange listing is not shown in the excerpts (ARDC is shown as NYSE: ARDC), so both_listed is null. The excerpts show a special meeting for 14 July 2015 and later 8-Ks with only headers or unrelated exhibits (investment policy change, director appointment); none states how the reorganization ended.
